name: bandit.phase4_target_relocation_observer_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live target-relocation control on a captured authoritative structural dispatch. The observer records the same dispatch before and after an explicit long-range debug player teleport; the camp-owned target must remain fixed and no ecology entity is edited.

steps.label: settle_target_relocation_fixture
steps.expected_visible_fact: the captured natural local-dispatch footing reaches normal gameplay

steps.label: preflight_authoritative_relocation_dispatch
steps.abort_reason: fixture did not contain the exact generation-1 local structural pair and stationary road target
steps.expected_immediate_state: the authoritative owner starts with the exact pair pinned to the road lead before player relocation

steps.label: open_pre_relocation_ecology_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the normal overmap opens with the DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE ecology overlay

steps.label: select_pre_relocation_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the dispatch at OMT 137,51,0 is selected with its stable ID and road destination before relocation

steps.label: close_pre_relocation_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the overmap closes without moving the avatar

steps.label: open_pre_relocation_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the existing debug console opens on the selected natural dispatch

steps.label: record_pre_relocation_incident
steps.expected_visible_fact: the first atomic incident pair records player OMT 135,51,0 and the selected natural dispatch

steps.label: close_pre_relocation_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the console closes before the explicit player relocation

steps.label: open_debug_long_teleport
steps.expected_visible_fact: Debug Functions opens Teleport then the ordinary long-range overmap destination picker

steps.label: teleport_player_twelve_omt_south
steps.expected_visible_fact: the avatar is deliberately relocated twelve OMT south while the ecology entity is untouched
steps.failure_rule: This debug player relocation is explicit test footing, not a natural ecology transition and not an entity intervention.

steps.label: advance_one_turn_after_player_relocation
steps.expected_visible_fact: one ordinary turn gives the second incident a distinct turn identity and lets normal owner load-transfer run

steps.label: open_post_relocation_ecology_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the observer reopens around the relocated avatar

steps.label: reselect_post_relocation_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same canonical dispatch is reselected at OMT 137,51,0 after player relocation, including any honest local-to-abstract owner transfer

steps.label: close_post_relocation_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the post-relocation overmap closes with the dispatch reselected

steps.label: open_post_relocation_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the existing console opens for the reselected authoritative dispatch

steps.label: record_post_relocation_incident
steps.expected_visible_fact: the second atomic incident pair records the changed player OMT and unchanged dispatch identity, position, and destination

steps.label: close_post_relocation_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the console closes before authoritative save/writeback

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_relocation_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved-player mtime baseline is recorded before final writeback

steps.label: open_save_prompt_after_target_relocation
steps.abort_reason: save-and-quit prompt was not visibly proven after player relocation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the case-sensitive save-and-quit prompt is open

steps.label: confirm_save_after_target_relocation
steps.expected_visible_fact: uppercase Y confirms the proven save prompt

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_relocation_save
steps.abort_reason: saved-player mtime did not advance after the relocation control
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run relocated player and authoritative camp state were written to disk

steps.label: audit_authoritative_target_after_player_relocation
steps.abort_reason: the saved authoritative outing identity or road target changed after moving only the player
steps.expected_immediate_state: the exact generation-1 pair still targets the same camp-owned road lead; owner may legitimately transfer across load boundaries

evidence_contract.claim: moving the real avatar twelve OMT through an explicit debug teleport does not drag the authoritative generation-1 structural dispatch, its current OMT, or its camp-owned road destination
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: the captured natural producer supplies the real local dispatch and DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE is the only fixture-added mutation; the same-run player teleport is explicit debug footing, not natural movement or an ecology entity intervention
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: Coordinator inspection must compare the two ecology_incident JSON/PNG pairs: player_omt changes, while selected canonical ID, selected OMT, destination, route, member IDs, and empty intervention ledger remain stable except for an honest owner/load transfer.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No relocation credit without the exact pre/post saved target audit and both compact incident pairs; a missing/stale selection, changed target, player@ target, or ecology intervention is red.
